newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan aluminium exports up 70.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan aluminium exports up 70.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 21,022 tonnes in January, up 70.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Tuesday.
China's exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys rose by 73.9 percent to 14,878 tonnes in January compared with the same period in 1996, the figures showed.
Exports of alumina were zero in January.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 37,847 tonnes in January, up 28.7 percent compared with the year-ago period, the figures showed.
Imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys rose by 8.8 percent to 15,503 tonnes in January compared with the same period in 1996.
China's imports of alumina reached 90,000 tonnes in January, up 10.7 percent year-on-year, the figures showed.
